source_name: Good Food Middle East Awards 2025 — KSA categories (Riyadh winners)
publisher: Good Food Middle East (CPI Media Group)
coverage_note: 16th edition, ceremony 23 Jan 2026 in Dubai (winners article published 24 Jan 2026). KSA categories: Best Café Attachè, Casual Dining Sold Out, Fine Dining Takara, plus hotel/staycation awards (not restaurants). The winners page gives no city: Takara is in Al Khobar (dropped); Sold Out started in the Eastern Province with a later Riyadh branch, so the winning location cannot be placed in Riyadh (dropped); Attachè is recorded because Good Food ME and Arab News place it in Riyadh's Diplomatic Quarter. KSA nominees are not published. 2026 awards ceremony is set for 3 Feb 2027. Paywall: no.
